title: ARGUS TRUE_DEPTH impact and capacity curves verified
summary: ARGUS now computes deterministic static-book impact and displayed-capacity curves from authenticated TRUE_DEPTH snapshots. For requested size grids it reports displayed fill fraction, VWAP, marginal price, average slippage from best, implementation shortfall from mid and microprice, consumed levels and book exhaustion. It also reports displayed capacity within configurable marginal-price thresholds. The result explicitly assumes static_visible_depth_only and does not claim queue priority, latency, hidden liquidity, replenishment, future cancellation, routing, or actual future fills.
evidence: exact-head subsystem-evolution workflow run 36903974346 completed success
Linux and Windows ARGUS causal subsystem jobs passed
duplicate levels, crossed/locked books, invalid sizes, non-finite depth and off-tick geometry fail closed
displayed capacity is marginal-price capacity, not an average-slippage or fill guarantee
